_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY - this is a shape reference, not balance. The tiers, weights, wave bands and
rewards below were chosen to show one of each schema feature, not because any of them is a
good idea. Nothing in the mod rolls this table. Delete it, or shadow it from your own datapack
at data/cobblemon_roguelite/roguelite/reward_tables/example.json, and write your own tables at
Any field whose name starts with '_' is ignored, which is where comments go. Every other
unknown field is an error, so a typo is reported instead of silently taking a default.
_tiers: Picked first, by weight interpolated from the curve at the current wave. Omit the whole block for a flat table.
_entries: Picked second, by flat weight within the chosen tier. min_wave/max_wave gate existence, not likelihood.

entries._reward: Omitting "ability" means the hidden ability, i.e. an ability patch.
Bag items cover evolution items, healing, and anything else used from the run bag.
